record.title: Turkey Iran COVID road-crossing restrictions
record.scope: Gürbulak / Bazargan and other land gates
record.crossings: Gürbulak / Bazargan and other land gates
record.direction: Iran to Türkiye initially; controlled outbound trade treated separately
record.movement: Passengers and ordinary road-vehicle movement; freight exceptions and substitute arrangements varied.
record.exceptions: Controlled exports and transit toward Iran continued initially; screened Turkish returns were permitted at Gürbulak. Rail wagons without personnel were permitted from March 4. On May 5 entry processing began for 280 waiting trucks under quarantine and health precautions; driver nationality was not specified.
record.enforcement: Official operational accounts support the freight arrangements; independent gate-by-gate observation is not established.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current-status inference
record.context: Road restrictions operated alongside substitute rail and contact-free freight arrangements.
record.uncertainty: June 4 concerns general international freight restoration, not passenger reopening or the first permitted truck entry. A May 6 Trade Ministry notice identifies the May 5 exception as returning Turkish trucks already inside Iran before closure; newly arriving transit trucks were excluded. Driver nationality is not separately established. Rail substitution and screened returns preclude an all-traffic continuous interval; no matched continuous category is yet reconstructed.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty
